reason: My architect already does 3D for us, and I bill architecture and pre-construction cost-plus, so a new $1,500 line only goes in if the homeowner agrees to pay it. I'm not going to eat that cost or add a vendor to a process that already works.
objection: My architect already does 3D renderings as part of his package, so this is a second bill for something the homeowner thinks they already get. I'd have to convince each client to pay extra, and I don't want that fight on every job.
would_change_my_mind: If it turned out clients actually sign faster and stop making expensive change orders after framing, and I saw it on my own plan over lunch, I might try it on one job where the homeowner agrees to the line item.
